site.name: Jeel Al-Toufan Academy
site.mission: The Academy's mission is to empower Arab and Muslim youth through intensive educational, cognitive, and political programs that keep pace with the challenges and stakes of the flood, relying on scientific curricula and practical tools to strengthen identity and support the Palestinian cause in various fields.
site.description: The digital home of Jeel Al-Toufan Academy: training programs, live sessions, content and knowledge, and events.
